Hi Billy, welcome. This walkthrough was built for you and Billy Bob Electric, from what you told us. You already have the revenue base, job value, and lead flow for AI to matter quickly. Your average customer value is around one thousand dollars, and your annual revenue baseline is around two million dollars, so every missed urgent call and every forgotten estimate follow up has real value.

The first opportunity for you is emergency dispatch. Your team should not treat an outage, burning smell, EV charger quote, and routine lighting question the same way. Your AI layer can ask the right safety questions, capture the address and callback number, and route the urgent jobs first.

The second opportunity for you is quote follow up. Your panel upgrades, EV charger installs, and lighting projects deserve consistent reminders. Your office should not have to remember every open estimate manually.
